seo_desc: Stop losing money by forgetting to update your clients' inflation rates. We develop custom software to manage B2B contract renewals automatically.
author_pitch: I have seen small service companies lose their entire annual profit margin simply by forgetting to update the inflation rate in their clients' contracts. My goal is to create databases that shield your profitability by alerting you before every renewal.
title: Custom Contract Software: Automate Your Renewals and Rate Increases
body:
Is your company losing money every year because you forget to apply the inflation rate increase to your recurring clients' contracts?

If you manage recurring services like maintenance, cleaning, security, or consulting, your profitability depends on updating your rates on time. Tracking the renewal dates of dozens or hundreds of B2B clients using spreadsheets or paper planners is a guaranteed disaster. Months go by, you keep charging last year's price while your labor costs rise, and you end up working almost for free out of fear of claiming the increase late.

The trap of standard calendar alarms

Many managers try to solve this by setting reminders in their email that end up ignored or accidentally deleted during a busy day. Leaving your business profitability at the mercy of your memory is the fastest path to closure.

Our solution: Active Database for Contracts

At LANZAESTUDIO we design a custom system that centralizes all your commercial agreements, automatically calculating deadlines and margins so you never miss a renewal.

  1. Early Expiration Alerts: The system warns you months in advance about which contracts are expiring, giving you room to negotiate new terms without rushing.
  2. Automatic Inflation Calculation: The database cross-references the original amount with the official price index, showing you the exact fee you should charge this year.
  3. One-Click Addendum Generation: Forget drafting documents from scratch; the software generates the renewal addendum in PDF format ready to send to the client.
  4. Profitability Tracking per Client: Analyze at a glance how much real margin each account leaves you after deducting updated operational costs.

The Real Impact on Your Commercial Margins

  • Recovery of Hidden Profits: You go back to charging what is fair, ensuring that the increase in fixed costs does not eat up your small business's margin.
  • Zero Administrative Oversights: You eliminate the stress of reviewing papers at the end of the month; the system monitors your client portfolio permanently and autonomously.
  • Professional B2B Image: Your clients receive timely and well-documented update notifications, avoiding awkward arguments over late notices.
